name: Zoom
shortInfo: Zoom is a video conferencing and communication platform that enables virtual meetings, webinars, and collaboration.
brief: Zoom is an information sharing, communication and collaboration platform for streamlining communications, thus enabling increased employee engagement, optimized in-person time, and improved productivity.
about:
Get access to Meetings and Meeting Reports through this Zoom connector. It enables streaming of relevant Zoom data into a user determined data warehouse automatically once you configure the relevant pipelines.

Check more about Zoom api documentation [here](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/).
availableData:
[Meetings](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/zoom/pipelines/meetings.html)

Access granular data detailing all activities that occurred during a Zoom meeting.

  
[Meeting Reports](<http://Meeting Reports>)

Access meeting reports from Zoom Meetings.
